card.title: Passkeys
card.description: Sign in with Touch ID, Windows Hello, your phone or a security key instead of a password.
card.statusEnabled_one: Passkey sign-in is on, {{count}} passkey registered
card.statusEnabled_other: Passkey sign-in is on, {{count}} passkeys registered
card.statusOff: Passkey sign-in is off until you add a passkey
card.testFailedTitle: The passkey test did not pass

empty.title: No passkeys yet
empty.body: Passkeys are phishing resistant, faster than a password and stay on your device or password manager. Add one to sign in with a touch or a glance.

nudge.backupTitle: Add a second passkey as a backup
nudge.backupBody: With only one passkey, losing that device means falling back to your password. Register another device or a security key.

row.syncedHint: Backed up by your passkey provider and available on your other devices.
row.deviceBoundHint: Stays on this authenticator and cannot be recovered if you lose it.
row.renameFailed: Could not rename this passkey. Try again.

remove.title: Remove this passkey?
remove.description: "{{name}}" will no longer be able to sign in to this account.
remove.lastWarning: This is your only passkey. Make sure you can still sign in with your password or two-factor authentication.
remove.blockedBody: This is your only way to sign in. Add another passkey, a password or two-factor authentication first.
remove.blockedFailed: Could not remove this passkey. Try again.

addDialog.title: Add a passkey
addDialog.description: Name it so you recognize it later, then follow your browser's prompt.

errors.cancelled: The passkey prompt was closed before it finished. Nothing was saved.
errors.timeout: The browser waited too long for your passkey. Try again when you are ready.
errors.alreadyRegistered: This authenticator already has a passkey for this account. Use a different device or remove the old passkey first.
errors.unsupported: This browser or device does not support passkeys. Try another browser or a security key.
errors.insecureOrigin: Passkeys only work on the exact address configured as the dashboard URL over https. Open the dashboard from that address and try again.
errors.rejected: The server could not verify this passkey. Try again, or use a different authenticator.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.unavailable: Passkeys are not set up on this server yet. Ask an administrator to set the dashboard URL.
errors.lastMethod: This is your only way to sign in. Add another passkey, a password or two-factor first.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong with the passkey. Try again.
